findings.description: The new adapter promises bounded write/fsync/fallocate/observation/close completion without naming an OS-call containment and in-flight-writer mechanism.
findings.evidence: Proposal124/128/130/142/146 requires finite deadlines, preserves uncertain effects and disallows dropping in-flight calls, but the API is synchronous and supplies no supervised completion mechanism. Local regular-file status and before/after clock checks do not bound a stalled fsync/fallocate/stat operation. The retained owner model has outer resource/watchdog limits and explicitly does not implement adapter failure supervision; those limits cannot establish future receipt delivery or safe writer stoppage.
findings.fix: Name a bounded owner-controlled I/O supervision arrangement, finite request/result/membership/diagnostic limits and timeout disposition. Keep every live operation/descriptor in the original authority until completion is proved; return canonical failure without late success, replay, premature seal/release or uncertain-file deletion. Freeze early/no-session, partial-allocation, non-null-reservation observation failure, unload failure and release-ack uncertainty variants, then require matched completion/stall/error controls. No privileged isolation or new service is required.
